title: 06 — Optional Wrapper (Atoms)
system_instructions: You are working on step 06 of the Atoms pipeline in @vsk/ui-kit.
Communicate with the human developer/designer in Russian (RU), but keep code identifiers, file paths, shell commands, and other technical literals in English.
goal: Only when justified, create a thin, typed wrapper around the Taiga component for the atom.

roles.agent: Generate a minimal standalone wrapper component if truly needed.
roles.developer: Decide whether a wrapper is necessary; review the API and implementation.
roles.designer: Optionally confirm that wrapper-level defaults/variants match design.

inputs_expected: Existing Taiga API usage and story behavior.
Any requirements to standardize API or enforce defaults beyond plain Taiga.

actions.description: Confirm whether a wrapper is actually needed (standardizing API, enforcing defaults, encapsulating logic, or applying tokens that cannot be attached externally).
human_checklist: Есть ли реальная потребность в обёртке поверх Taiga (а не в сториз/доках/токенах)?
Нет ли риска дублирования или расхождения с оригинальным API Taiga?

actions.description: If approved, create a standalone wrapper component in the atom folder and re-export it.
human_checklist: Компонент standalone, с типизированными @Input/@Output и минимальной разметкой?
Используются только публичные API/директивы Taiga, без опоры на приватный DOM?

acceptance_criteria: Wrapper exists only if explicitly approved.
Wrapper compiles, tests pass, and stories still function.
next_step_prompt: Use `docs/prompts/atoms/07-validate-and-coverage.md` to validate build and tests.
